ranks.role_assignment: Reduction stream directly from bucket Cast launches; remaining Python stream from native offload/coordinator allgather-stream creation and wait_stream source.

queries.buckets: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(CAST(p.startNs AS INTEGER),CAST(p.endNs AS INTEGER),p.globalTid)) FROM PYTORCH_API p JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=p.name WHERE n.value LIKE 'dep/bucket/%'
queries.casts:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT json_group_array(json_array(h.startNs,h.endNs,h.globalTid,t.streamId)) FROM compute_view c JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=c.globalTaskId JOIN CANN_API h ON h.connectionId=t.connectionId WHERE c.op_type='Cast' AND h.name IN (SELECT id FROM STRING_IDS WHERE value='launch')
